item.title: Echo Subsea Cable Establishes New Trans-Pacific Route via Singapore
item.summary: The Echo subsea cable has recently been installed in Singapore, establishing a second trans-Pacific route between the United States and Southeast Asia that entirely avoids the South China Sea.
